definitions.explanation: The raised area at a train station where passengers board and alight from trains.

examples.japanese: プラットホームで{電車|でんしゃ}を{待|ま}つ。
examples.english: Wait for the train on the platform.

examples.japanese: {特急|とっきゅう}は3{番|ばん}プラットホームから{発車|はっしゃ}します。
examples.english: The express train departs from platform 3.

examples.japanese: プラットホームの{端|はし}は{危|あぶ}ないので、{白線|はくせん}の{内側|うちがわ}でお{待|ま}ちください。
examples.english: The edge of the platform is dangerous, so please wait inside the white line.

notes:
VARIANT:
Often abbreviated to ホーム in everyday speech. Both forms are common.
・プラットホーム - full form (more formal)
・ホーム - shortened form (casual, common in announcements)

NUMBERING:
Platforms are numbered in Japanese stations:
・1{番|ばん}ホーム / 1{番線|ばんせん} - Platform 1 / Track 1

ANNOUNCEMENTS:
・「3{番線|ばんせん}に{電車|でんしゃ}が{参|まい}ります」- A train is arriving on track 3

NOTE:
The loanword comes from English "platform." In computing and business, プラットフォーム (with different vowel length) refers to software/business platforms.
